=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:161 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The cleanup script does not handle potential failure when reading source issue labels via `mcp__github__issue_read`.
  WHY: If the `mcp__github__issue_read` call fails (e.g., due to transient network or MCP errors), the script does not archive the stopped session, leaving it active and visible in the session list, requiring manual operator cleanup despite the issue having been resumed.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:103 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The issue-mode stop sequence does not define a failure-handling path if `set_session_title` fails transiently.
  WHY: If the rename fails, the session keeps its pre-stop title (e.g., `… — validation 1/3 — blocked`). The Zombie-checker cleanup only matches titles that end in ` — blocked on issue`. Thus, the stopped session is not archived and remains visible even after the issue resumes.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:161 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cleanup predicate "when the source issue no longer carries `ai:claude-blocked`" is not robust against read errors.
  WHY: If the label check fails, the predicate evaluates to False (the issue *might* still carry the label, or the call failed). The cleanup then fails to archive the session, even if it is no longer blocked. While acceptable as a "fail-closed" approach, it should be documented as part of the cleanup logic.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
